title: Lock&lock 135 fluid oz
text: Lock&lock 135 fluid oz. Of all the airtight containers I've purchased, I like this brand the best.  Easiest to wash... easiest to use... I purchased a number of different sizes and find them useful for more than just food storage. I use the one with the handle to hold my sewing kit. This one works wonderfully for saltine crackers, or other crackers that come in tube stacks.  ALSO... I DO NOT receive any compensation for my reviews in any way.  I always update my reviews if new info would be useful.

description: Get pantry perfect and organize your dried goods, food items, baking ingredients, snacks and more with the Easy Essentials Pantry 8-Cup Rectangular Food Storage Container. Ideal for storing flours, sugars, pantry items and foods, this versatile 8-cup container features a lightweight design that makes it easier to handle, even on higher cabinet shelves. Lock & Lock's patented 4-hinge locking system has been durability tested to last up to 3 million uses, and the enhanced silicone seal is 100% airtight to keep foods fresh longer and 100% leakproof to prevent messy drips and sloppy spills. BPA-free construction provides a healthy storage solution for the cupboard, refrigerator, freezer, pantry, or anywhere your foods need to stay fresh, and Easy Essentials containers are microwave safe for convenient reheating and dishwasher safe for easy cleanup. For a 100% airtight food storage container that keeps foods fresh and ready to go, reach for the Easy Essentials Pantry 8-Cup Rectangular Food Storage Container.
